title: Triage dispatch carries a loop issue's finding as loopctl-authored fields

story.as_a: triage session working a chg loop issue
story.i_want_to: receive the finding's kind and evidence as trusted fields beside the untrusted issue text
story.so_that: my verdict rests on loopctl's own record of the problem, not on an issue body anyone could edit

rationale: Split from AC-51.3.2 when US-51.3 was built. The record now carries loop_finding_id, but the triage object is a wire contract the loopctl-runner reads (Loopctl.ApiSpec.RunnerContract.RunnerTriage, a 48_000-byte object budget, its template pastes fields by name). Adding fields is a contract version bump and a runner template change in another repository, so it cannot ship inside one loopctl story. Until it ships, triage sees the evidence only inside the issue body, as untrusted text.

acceptance_criteria.description: RunnerTriage gains an optional loop_finding object (finding id, kind, fingerprint, occurrences, fix_attempts, and a bounded evidence map of scalars) under the existing object byte cap, with the contract version bumped and the measured worst-case figures asserted by name in runner_contract_test.exs.
TriagePayload.build/1 fills loop_finding from the record's loop_finding_id by a lookup in chg_findings of the same tenant, never from the issue text; a record with no loop_finding_id carries none.

The loopctl-runner triage template renders loop_finding as loopctl-authored context beside the untrusted block; agreed with the runner's maintaining session over the loopctl-runner coordination channel before the contract change merges.

test_cases.name: a loop record carries its finding
expected_results: loop_finding has the finding's kind and evidence
the object fits the byte cap

test_cases.name: another tenant's finding id carries nothing
preconditions: a record whose loop_finding_id names another tenant's finding
